branch: busy state vs background tasks — shells don't suspend, CLI-initiated turns still show Stop
provenance: Every frame shape here is from a REAL stream-json capture (2026-08-12, CLI 2.1.228, scratchpad wire-short.jsonl / wire.jsonl): a `Bash run_in_background:true` turn, recorded end to end. The captures established both defects this pins: (1) `background_tasks_changed` reports background shells as task_type local_bash, but the CLI's own busy set (fVy in the binary) excludes local_bash — the shell's `result` IS the true end of the request, so counting it in pendingBgTasks parked busy=true for the life of the process; (2) after the shell completes, the CLI starts a notification turn with NO user frame on the wire — message_start is the only render-time signal — and the panel stayed on Send while it printed. The setBusy(true) in the setup steps stands in for sendTurn's busy half without bridging a real message to the CLI.

steps.note: setup: the panel is mid-turn, as after a real send

expect.why: busy on, as sendTurn leaves it

steps.note: a background SHELL joins the roster and the turn's true result arrives while it runs (sleep-30 ordering) — the result must finalize, because the CLI is idle from here

expect.why: a shell does not suspend the turn — this result is the true end
the chip still shows the live shell — filtering is pendingBgTasks-only, the roster is untouched

steps.note: the shell completes and the CLI starts its notification turn — NO user frame precedes it on the wire (measured; the transcript persists one, the stream does not), so message_start must flip busy itself or Stop is unreachable while text prints

expect.why: a turn WE did not start is still a turn
Stop is reachable while the notification turn streams — the reported bug

steps.note: the notification turn's own result finalizes it normally

NEGATIVE CONTROL — a background SUBAGENT still suspends: its intermediate result must NOT finalize the turn. This is the branch the local_bash filter must not eat, and an unknown task_type must land on this side too (deny-list)
agent-type task on the roster, then an intermediate result — swallowed, spinner keeps going

expect.why: an agent task suspends — the intermediate result must not finalize

steps.note: the agent reports back: roster empties, the real result finalizes
